item.question: What is the purpose of data time travel in reinforcement learning for market making?
item.answer: The purpose of data time travel is to maximize the consistency of the influence of the new RL agent's actions with what happened next in the system, i.e., with the next effective events conditionally on the state (static and dynamic) of the system.
